tmp=$(mktemp -d)
cat > "$tmp/resolve.py" <<'PYEOF'
import sys, difflib

def read(p):
    try:
        with open(p, 'r', errors='surrogateescape', newline='') as f:
            return f.read().split('\n')
    except OSError:
        return []

ours = read(sys.argv[1])
theirs = read(sys.argv[2])
base = read(sys.argv[3])
if any('\x00' in s for s in ours + theirs + base):
    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(theirs))
    sys.exit(0)
if not any(s.strip() for s in ours):
    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(theirs))
    sys.exit(0)
if not any(s.strip() for s in theirs):
    sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(ours))
    sys.exit(0)
base_set = set(base)
dropped = base_set - set(ours)
res = [l for l in theirs if l not in dropped]
sm = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, base, ours, autojunk=False)
for tag, i1, i2, j1, j2 in sm.get_opcodes():
    if tag != 'insert':
        continue
    new = [l for l in ours[j1:j2] if l not in base_set and l not in res]
    if not new:
        continue
    pos = None
    for k in range(i1 - 1, -1, -1):
        if base[k] in res:
            pos = len(res) - 1 - res[::-1].index(base[k])
            break
    if pos is None:
        res[0:0] = new
    else:
        res[pos + 1:pos + 1] = new
sys.stdout.write('\n'.join(res))
PYEOF
git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U -z | tr '\0' '\n' > "$tmp/conflicted"
while IFS= read -r path; do
  [ -n "$path" ] || continue
  git show ":1:$path" > "$tmp/base" 2>/dev/null || : > "$tmp/base"
  git show ":2:$path" > "$tmp/ours" 2>/dev/null || : > "$tmp/ours"
  git show ":3:$path" > "$tmp/theirs" 2>/dev/null || : > "$tmp/theirs"
  python3 "$tmp/resolve.py" "$tmp/ours" "$tmp/theirs" "$tmp/base" > "$tmp/out"
  cp "$tmp/out" "$path"
  git add -- "$path"
done < "$tmp/conflicted"
if git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  GIT_EDITOR=true git commit --no-edit
fi
refused_program.intent: Merge upstream into the current branch and resolve dependency-file conflicts so the local side keeps its removals and gains everything upstream added.

postconditions.description: the index has no remaining conflict entries
postconditions.name: no_unmerged_paths

postconditions.description: upstream's tip is an ancestor of HEAD
postconditions.name: upstream_is_ancestor

postconditions.description: HEAD is a merge commit whose second parent is upstream's tip
postconditions.name: upstream_commit_is_second_parent

postconditions.description: no conflict markers remain in the tree at HEAD
postconditions.name: no_conflict_markers

postconditions.description: every line upstream added relative to the merge base is present in the merged tree
postconditions.name: upstream_additions_present
postconditions.probe:
rc=0
mb=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2)
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  if comm -23 <(comm -13 <(git show "$mb:$f" 2>/dev/null | sort) <(git show "HEAD^2:$f" | sort) | sort -u) <(git show "HEAD:$f" | sort -u) | grep -q .; then
    rc=1
  fi
done < <(git diff --name-only -z "$mb" HEAD^2)
exit $rc

postconditions.description: lines the local branch dropped that upstream still carried are absent from the merged tree
postconditions.name: local_removals_absent
postconditions.probe:
rc=0
mb=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 HEAD^2)
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  if comm -12 <(git show "$mb:$f" 2>/dev/null | sort -u) <(git show "HEAD^2:$f" | sort -u) | comm -23 - <(git show "HEAD^1:$f" | sort -u) | comm -12 - <(git show "HEAD:$f" | sort -u) | grep -q .; then
    rc=1
  fi
done < <(git diff --name-only -z "$mb" HEAD^2)
exit $rc

preconditions.description: the local branch dropped at least one line that upstream still carries in a file both sides touched
preconditions.name: local_removals_exist
preconditions.probe:
mb=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})
rc=1
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  if comm -12 <(git show "$mb:$f" 2>/dev/null | sort -u) <(git show "{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}:$f" | sort -u) | comm -23 - <(git show "HEAD:$f" | sort -u) | grep -q .; then
